name: yutori
description: A programming language for describing Linear Optimisation problems. We create an *abstract syntax tree* of symbolic algebraic algebra. A computer algebra system then simplifies the expressions. We then have modular compiler backends.

name: [Anki-Panky](https://github.com/kamalsacranie/anki-panky)
description: Markdown to Anki deck compilation programme written in Haskell. Parse Markdown using Pandoc to produce individual card ASTs which are then compiled into an Anki database.

name: [Camlbinators](https://github.com/kamalsacranie/camlbinators)
description: A novel parser combinator library for creating source-mapped ASTs useful for creating developer tooling. Source metadata data can be colocated with AST data types which can be used by tooling for great static analysis.

name: [Fuzzy Camls](https://github.com/kamalsacranie/fuzzy-camls)
description: A synthetic data generator that takes an `EBNF`-style grammar and randomly generates source data based on the user-specified grammar. Developed for fuzz-testing parsers.

name: Kamal's World
description: From-scratch game engine written in C++ using OpenGL. Objects can be parsed in or procedurally generated and textures can be applied to objects. A very OO heavy project.

name: Flower Stamp
description: U-Net architecture neural network used to segment pictures of flowers for lazer cutting stamps.
